title: Short Answer Questions
instructions: Provide detailed answers to the following questions. Readjust the text box size as needed

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of a program in regards to the CPU? ___
answers: The purpose of a program is to tell the CPU what to do. A program is a list of instructions that cause the CPU to perform/execute operations.

questions.prompt: What does CPU stand for and what is its function? ___
answers: Central Processing Unit. Runs programs. Executes instructions. Tells the computer what to do. The brain of the computer.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the build process that uses a compiler, assembler, and linker? ___
answers: The build process combines the compiler, assembler, and linker to convert source code into an executable program.

questions.prompt: What are the 5 steps (focus) in the program development cycle (in creating code/programs), which is repeated until no errors can be found in the program? ___
answers: 4. Test the Executable Code (find logic errors/bugs)

questions.prompt: What are the three lessons and approach of problem-solving techniques we learned via the following exercises in class? The Fox, the Goose and the Corn; Sliding Eight; Sudoku. ___
answers: The Fox, the Goose and the Corn: Solution-based or process of elimination problem-solving. (Restriction and Rules/Constraints based.)
Sliding Eight: Strategies or employing techniques to systematically solve the problem. Planning and systematic approach.
Sudoku: Constraints- (most constrained variable) and Pattern-based problem-solving. (Algorithmic)

questions.prompt: What does RAM stand for and what is its function? ___
answers: Random Access Memory. Work area of the computer. Stores a program while the program is running, as well as data that the program is working with.
